refusal.prose: vllm on srv2 did not reach health with an allocation inside 900s: 'timeout code=000 mib=1'. Launcher was 'docker'. Nothing was measured. Check /tmp/vllm-serving.log on the host (pip) or `docker logs mcgyvr-vllm` (docker); the known causes here are a cold weights download inside the start budget and a KV cache that will not fit the card at the requested max_model_len.
